faq.a: Recep is associated with the Arabic form رَجَب, whose core sense is recep; a month name (turkish form of rajab).

faq.q: What is the origin of Recep?
faq.a: Recep is associated with Arabic. Recep is the Turkish form of Arabic رَجَب (Rajab), the name of the seventh Islamic month.
Yes — the underlying form رَجَب is Arabic.
Recep can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Recep should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Rajab is not a Quranic personal name.
